name: Yucatec Maya
notes: STRUCTURAL ADSTRATE STUB (not a modelled G2P target). Yucatec Maya (Mayan) is an indigenous adstrate of Yucatan-Peninsula Mexican Spanish. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the Latin American Spanish varieties that reference it as an adstrate have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table. A table needs a cited description of the Yucatec Maya orthography and the sound value of each letter; the classification reference listed in sources does not give one.

sources.author: Campbell, Lyle
sources.title: American Indian Languages: The Historical Linguistics of Native America
sources.notes: Reference for the classification and geographic distribution of this contact language (structural adstrate node only).
